docText: System Admin only; does not affect the underlying Power BI report definition
graphText: System Admin only; does not affect the underlying Power BI report definition. This remains the ONLY permission gating reporting-api.ttl's admin catalog operations (Op_AdminCreateReport et al.) — there is not yet a per-domain equivalent of Communications' create/edit/activate/delete verbs, so a Staffing Administrator cannot today manage Staffing's own report catalog entries independently of a System Admin. See DESIGN-SPIKES.md item 3, which already covers bringing the ReportDefinitionAggregate lifecycle up to Communications' template-lifecycle richness (draft/published status, availability window) — delegating catalog management to per-domain manage permissions belongs in that same design pass, not as a quick rename, since it requires new authorization checks on the admin API operations themselves.

docText: Not directly role-assignable; granted implicitly when the user holds the report's declared domain permission at an appropriate scope. The Reporting API enforces this — it is not a standalone assignable permission.
graphText: Not directly role-assignable; granted implicitly when the user holds the report's declared domain permission (PermissionKey, e.g. reporting.credentialing-reports.view) at an appropriate scope. The Reporting API enforces this — it is a technical/documentation gate on the embed-token endpoint's behavior, not a standalone assignable permission. The real authorization decision ('does this user hold the PermissionKey declared on this specific report?') is delegated to IAM and evaluated per-report; scope.SystemWide here describes this permission's own nominal scope, not the effective scope of the underlying domain permission it delegates to.
